functionality.rationale: A false negative permits meaningless history while a false positive blocks every contributor and task transition.

security.rationale: The policy parses local Git metadata and does not process product trust-boundary input or credentials.

performance.rationale: Message and range checks add bounded text parsing to commits and CI.

compatibility.rationale: Existing task records and history must remain valid while every future harness commit adopts the new format.

concurrency.rationale: Commit validation is read-only and process-local; task locking and worktree ownership are unchanged.

platform.rationale: The hook and shell entrypoints must behave consistently on macOS, Linux, and Git for Windows.

persistence.rationale: Bootstrap writes repository-local core.hooksPath configuration but does not change product data.

adr.rationale: Commit hygiene is an internal engineering policy and changes no public or expensive-to-reverse architecture contract.

architecture.rationale: Runtime dependency boundaries are unchanged; the policy governs Git history and harness automation only.

roadmap.rationale: The task improves engineering governance without completing a product capability milestone.
